description: ValidatedPath contains only usize fields (anchor_index, depth). It derives Debug but not Clone, PartialEq, or Eq. A result type that callers may want to store, compare across test assertions, or cache is missing these basic derives. Any caller who wants to assert_eq! on a ValidatedPath must destructure it manually. Adding derives is non-breaking.
title: ValidatedPath missing Clone, PartialEq/Eq derives
